about: Luna Offline: diary, to-do, notes, money, questions. One line per action; examples in <action>.txt.

actions.calendar: an appointment or event on a day / at a time → Google Calendar
actions.task: something to do, buy, ring, fix, book → TaskNotes to-do
actions.note: something to remember, an idea, info → TaskNotes notes
actions.money: spent, bought, a bill, card spend, paid the card → Where's My Money
actions.question: asks what's on, what's due, notes, money → Luna answers
actions.other: fridge food, use-by dates → Fridge (not hooked up yet)
